text:
𝗙𝗔𝗞𝗛𝗔𝗥 𝗦𝗛𝗢𝗪! 🇵🇰

Pakistan chased 326 to beat Sri Lanka by 3 wickets in the tri-series final in Lahore.

Fakhar Zaman 127 off 99, plus Minhas 61 off 31 sealed it with 9 balls left 🔥

#Cricket #PAKvSL

facebook.caption:
𝗙𝗔𝗞𝗛𝗔𝗥 𝗡𝗘 𝗝𝗜𝗧𝗔𝗬𝗔 𝗙𝗜𝗡𝗔𝗟! 🇵🇰🔥

👉 Lahore mein Pakistan ne Sri Lanka ka 326 ka target chase kiya
👉 Fakhar Zaman: 127 (99 balls), 6 chhakke
👉 Arafat Minhas: 61 sirf 31 balls mein
👉 3 wicket se jeet, 9 balls baaki

Is chase ka sabse bada hero kaun? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #PAKvSL #Cricket
